title: Washington and Lee University
summary: Campus projects including Woods Plaza, the Belfield estate feasibility study and the siting of the Vernon W. Holleman monument.
reviewNote: Existing text from the current site. The year, the role and the four-part story are still to come.
description: Miscellaneous landscape projects for Washington & Lee University including Woods Plaza, Belfield Estate feasibility study, and Vernon W. Holleman monument siting. Arthur Bartenstein also assisted Washington & Lee with relocation of the Lexington Train Station and site planning for the new Lenfest Center Fine Arts Building while with Frazier Associates.
